Which k Benchmarks to Run? Predicting a New
Model’s Remaining Benchmark Scores from a Few

Anonymous Author(s)
Affiliation
Address
email

Abstract
Running a new language model on every benchmark is costly, yet leaderboards
hold many earlier scores. We ask which k benchmarks to run on a new model
so that its remaining scores can be inferred, and how large k must be. We study
factor-model prediction with greedy Bayesian A-optimal selection (it minimises
the average posterior variance of the unrun scores) under a protocol that holds
out whole model families, fits before selecting, and uses paired, family-clustered
intervals, on dense blocks of MTEB and HELM MMLU results and on MTEB
matrices with missing cells. Three benchmarks close 81–96% of the gap between
the column-mean predictor and a leave-one-benchmark-out predictor, but 90%
needs one benchmark on HELM MMLU and nine or more on MTEB, with wide
intervals. Greedy selection beats random selection by 6–11% of the error, mostly
at k ≤ 3, and meets our pre-specified 10% margin on one pool of three; with
missing cells (21–70% observed) it closes 0.71–0.80 of the gap at k = 3 with the
pairwise-correlation predictor, against 0.55–0.74 for random. Later and stronger
models are predicted worse and too low. A closed-form risk is exact with known
parameters and gives the shape of the error-versus-k curve, but its level is 36–69%
off on real data.

shown.message:
I requested changes on `paper-repo`#9 (`candidate-v3`) because the PDF still contains one Type 3 font. The venue asks authors to fix Type 3 fonts (`VENUE.md` section 3), and the fix is one line in `paper/main.tex`.

Everything else I checked against the venue record passes:
- **Length:** the main text ends on page 9, references start on page 10, and the PDF is 25 pages.
- **Checklist:** it sits after the appendix inside the single PDF, with all 16 items answered.
- **Anonymity:** the paper is in default submission mode with no identifying names or links in the sources.
- **Style file:** `paper/neurips_2026.sty` is the unmodified kit file.

**Type 3 font:** `pdffonts` shows it on pages 1, 21, 22 and 24. It is the typewriter face rendered from a bitmap file, used for the "email" line of the author block and for the URLs in checklist items 5, 9 and 12. The figure fonts are fine.

**Fix I gave `paper-repo`:** add `\renewcommand{\ttdefault}{pcr}` after `\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}`. I built the candidate with that line. No Type 3 font remains, the page count is still 25, the text of pages 1–9 is unchanged, and References still start on page 10. `lmtt` does not work, since it still pulls in a bitmap font.

I'll approve once `pdffonts` on the rebuilt PDF shows no Type 3.
